title: They crack easily
text: They crack easily. An ice cube tray should last a long time, right? Well I've gone through three sets of these in the last year or so because they develop cracks as soon as you use them. I keep buying them because they're cheap at Target but I'm fed up. I just threw away another pair which had around 5 cracks in them each after maybe three months of use. I had one that cracked literally the very first time I used it.  Try something else.
